title: Triple links selected by a driven cubic
description: Cases 47087142 and 48000003 use a single driven cubic to determine all three sheets. In the degree-two return map each sheet contains a chaotic solenoid. The triples have absolute core linking invariants one and three and are inequivalent in three-space.
coordinates: Native cylindrical embedding at equal Cartesian scales. Each panel contains 28,000 consecutive states per component. The rotation includes all three components.
